data.name: Sample - Atlassian Confluence Cloud - 1.0.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Atlassian Confluence Cloud" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Update Custom Content
workflows.description: Update a custom content by id. At most one of spaceId, pageId, blogPostId, or customContentId is allowed in the request body. Note that if spaceId is specified, it must be the same as the spaceId used for creating the custom content as moving custom content to a different space is not supported.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Update Custom Content

workflows.name: Get Custom Contents
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of content from Atlassian Confluence Server based on the space key, page title and other input parameters you have specified.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Get Custom Contents

workflows.name: Get Specific Custom Content
workflows.description: Returns a specific piece of custom content.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Get Specific Custom Content

workflows.name: Create Custom Content
workflows.description: Creates a new custom content in the given space, page, blogpost or other custom content.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Create Custom Content

workflows.name: Create Footer Comment
workflows.description:
Create a footer comment. The footer comment can be made against several locations:

at the top level (specifying pageId or blogPostId in the request body)
as a reply (specifying parentCommentId in the request body)
against an attachment (note: this is different than the comments added via the attachment properties page on the UI, which are referred to as version comments)
against a custom content

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Create Footer Comment

workflows.name: Get Attachments
workflows.description: Returns all attachments. The number of results is limited by the limit parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the next URL present in the Link response header.

workflows.name: Get Groups
workflows.description: Returns all user groups. The returned groups are ordered alphabetically in ascending order by group name.

workflows.name: Get Audit Records
workflows.description: Returns all records in the audit log, optionally for a certain date range. This contains information about events like space exports, group membership changes, app installations, etc.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Get Audit Records

workflows.name: Get Users
workflows.description: Returns user details for the ids provided in the request. Currently this API returns a maximum of 100 results. If more than 100 account ids are passed in, then the first 100 will be returned.

workflows.name: Create Space
workflows.description: Creates a new space. Note, currently you cannot set space labels when creating a space.

workflows.name: Get Spaces
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of all spaces from Atlassian Confluence Cloud based on the input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Specific Spaces Details
workflows.description: Retrieves the details of a specific space from Atlassian Confluence Cloud based on the input parameters you specified.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Get Specific Spaces Details

workflows.name: Delete Custom Content
workflows.description: Delete a custom content by id from Atlassian Confluence Cloud.

arguments.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: Delete Custom Content
